prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1232; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full understanding of what happened at the intersection in Baytown.

A: I was driving through the intersection and wanted to make a left turn onto the cross street. I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic, and when I started the turn, a vehicle coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my car.

Q: Had the oncoming vehicle's headlights been visible to you before you began the turn?

A: Yes, I could see them, but they seemed far enough away. I thought I had time to complete the turn.

Q: Did you have a green signal, a yellow, or was there a left-turn arrow?

A: I believe it was a solid green. I was turning on the green light, though I can't say for sure whether the other driver had a signal.

Q: Where are you feeling injuries right now?

A: My lower back is sore and stiff. The impact pushed me against the seatbelt and my back tightened up. I've had some trouble sitting for long periods and bending over.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic that same day. They examined my back, took some X-rays, and diagnosed a muscle strain. I was told to rest, take anti-inflammatory medication, and follow up with my primary care doctor.

Q: Did you have any back problems before this collision?

A: I had some occasional stiffness from working long shifts, but nothing that stopped me from doing my job or my daily activities.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered the main points. I'm willing to provide my medical records if you need them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
